blocks.en: Purpose and Scope, Introduction, Definitions

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解本 FDA Guidance 的適用範疇：以 Container and Closure System Integrity Testing (CCIT) 取代 Stability Protocol 中的 Sterility Testing
blocks.en: Understand the scope of this FDA Guidance: replacing sterility testing in the stability protocol with Container and Closure System Integrity Testing (CCIT)

blocks.zh: 掌握 Sterility 作為 Stability Characteristic (安定性特性) 的法規依據 (21 CFR 211.166, 21 CFR 610.12)
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory basis for sterility as a stability characteristic (21 CFR 211.166, 21 CFR 610.12)

blocks.zh: 釐清本指引不適用的情境：產品放行前之無菌試驗 (Release Sterility Testing) 不可被取代
blocks.en: Clarify where the guidance does not apply: release sterility testing before product release cannot be replaced

blocks.zh: 了解 Container and Closure System (容器密封系統) 與 Packaging Component (包裝組件) 的定義
blocks.en: Understand the definitions of Container and Closure System and Packaging Component

blocks.zh: 認識 CCIT 對 CDMO 安定性計畫設計與法規申報策略的實務影響
blocks.en: Recognize the practical impact of CCIT on CDMO stability program design and regulatory filing strategy

blocks.zh: Preamble 前言聲明
blocks.en: Preamble Statement

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: FDA Guidance (FDA 指引文件): FDA Guidance 屬於「非約束性建議」(Nonbinding Recommendations)，不具法律強制力，但代表 FDA 目前對該議題的思考方向。在實務中，偏離 Guidance 建議需要有充分的科學理由支持。
blocks.en: FDA Guidance: An FDA Guidance consists of "Nonbinding Recommendations". It is not legally enforceable, but it represents FDA's current thinking on the topic. In practice, deviating from a Guidance recommendation requires solid scientific justification.

blocks.zh: Alternative Approach (替代方法): FDA 明確允許使用替代方法，前提是該方法符合適用法規的要求。這是風險導向法規架構的核心精神。
blocks.en: Alternative Approach: FDA explicitly permits alternative approaches, provided they satisfy the requirements of the applicable regulations. This is the core spirit of a risk-based regulatory framework.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: FDA Guidance 就像「行車建議路線」——導航推薦你走高速公路，但你可以選擇走省道，只要你能安全到達目的地即可。然而，如果你選擇了不同路線卻出了事，你需要解釋為何不按建議走。
blocks.en: An FDA Guidance is like a suggested driving route: the navigation app recommends the highway, but you may take the local roads as long as you arrive safely. However, if you choose a different route and have an accident, you will need to explain why you did not follow the recommendation.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，雖然 Guidance 不具法律約束力，但在 FDA 查廠或審查申請時，Guidance 的建議是 Inspector 與 Reviewer 的主要參考依據。不遵循建議但缺乏科學論據，可能導致 Form 483 觀察事項或 CRL (Complete Response Letter)。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, although a Guidance is not legally binding, its recommendations are the main reference for inspectors and reviewers during FDA inspections and application reviews. Not following the recommendations without scientific justification may result in a Form 483 observation or a CRL (Complete Response Letter).

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: FDA Guidance 與 21 CFR (Code of Federal Regulations) 在法律效力上有何差異？
blocks.en: How do an FDA Guidance and 21 CFR (Code of Federal Regulations) differ in legal force?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 選擇不採用本 Guidance 的建議，應如何準備科學理由以應對查廠？
blocks.en: If your CDMO chooses not to follow the recommendations of this Guidance, how should you prepare the scientific justification for an inspection?

blocks.zh: I. Purpose and Scope 目的與範疇
blocks.en: I. Purpose and Scope

blocks.zh: Container and Closure System Integrity (容器密封系統完整性): 指容器與密封件組成的系統，具備防止微生物侵入、維持產品無菌狀態的能力。這是 CCI (Container Closure Integrity) 的核心概念，後續在 USP <1207> 系列中被全面系統化。
blocks.en: Container and Closure System Integrity: The ability of a system made up of a container and closure to prevent microbial ingress and maintain the sterility of the product. This is the core concept of CCI (Container Closure Integrity), which was later fully systematized in the USP <1207> series.

blocks.zh: Stability Protocol (安定性計畫): 依據 21 CFR 211.166，製造商須維護書面安定性測試計畫。本指引僅針對此計畫中的無菌試驗部分，建議以 CCIT 替代。
blocks.en: Stability Protocol: Under 21 CFR 211.166, a manufacturer must maintain a written stability testing program. This guidance addresses only the sterility testing portion of that program and recommends replacing it with CCIT.

blocks.zh: Sterility as a Stability Characteristic (無菌性作為安定性特性): FDA 明確將無菌性定位為安定性特性之一，意味著安定性計畫必須包含確認產品在效期內持續維持無菌的措施。
blocks.en: Sterility as a Stability Characteristic: FDA explicitly positions sterility as one of the stability characteristics, meaning the stability program must include measures that confirm the product remains sterile throughout its shelf life.

blocks.zh: 想像你把食物放進真空密封袋保存在冰箱裡。安定性測試就像定期檢查食物是否變質（溫度、外觀、氣味），而「無菌性作為安定性特性」意味著你也必須定期確認密封袋沒有破損或漏氣。與其每次都打開袋子取樣培養（sterility test——一旦打開就破壞了密封），不如用儀器檢測密封袋的完整性（CCIT）更合理。
blocks.en: Imagine you store food in a vacuum-sealed bag in the refrigerator. Stability testing is like periodically checking whether the food has spoiled (temperature, appearance, smell), and "sterility as a stability characteristic" means you must also periodically confirm that the bag is not torn or leaking. Rather than opening the bag every time to take a sample for culture (the sterility test, which destroys the seal once the bag is opened), it makes more sense to check the integrity of the bag with an instrument (CCIT).

blocks.zh: 關鍵限制——不適用於放行無菌試驗：本 Guidance 明確指出 CCIT 不能取代產品放行前的無菌試驗（Release Sterility Testing, USP <71>）。原因是 CCIT 只能證明「容器沒有洩漏」，無法證明「產品本身是無菌的」。放行無菌試驗驗證的是製程本身是否成功產出無菌產品。
blocks.en: Key limitation: not applicable to release sterility testing. The Guidance explicitly states that CCIT cannot replace the sterility test performed before product release (Release Sterility Testing, USP <71>). The reason is that CCIT can only demonstrate that "the container does not leak"; it cannot demonstrate that "the product itself is sterile". Release sterility testing verifies whether the process itself has successfully produced a sterile product.

blocks.zh: 適用範圍廣泛：涵蓋生物製品、人用藥品、動物用藥品、醫療器械，以及核准前與核准後的安定性計畫，包括 IND (Investigational New Drug) 階段的試驗用藥。
blocks.en: Broad scope of application: It covers biological products, human drugs, animal drugs and medical devices, in both pre-approval and post-approval stability programs, including investigational drugs at the IND (Investigational New Drug) stage.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 安定性計畫設計：對於無菌充填代工廠而言，本指引意味著安定性計畫中每個時間點（如 3M, 6M, 9M, 12M, 18M, 24M, 36M）原本需要執行的 Sterility Test 可以改為 CCIT。這帶來多重好處：
blocks.en: CDMO stability program design: For a sterile fill-finish CDMO, this guidance means that the sterility test originally required at each time point of the stability program (e.g., 3M, 6M, 9M, 12M, 18M, 24M, 36M) can be replaced with CCIT. This brings multiple benefits:

blocks.zh: 節省樣品：Sterility Test 是破壞性測試，每次需耗用 20 個以上單位；CCIT 若採用非破壞性方法，測試後樣品可繼續用於其他安定性項目
blocks.en: Saves samples: The sterility test is destructive and consumes 20 or more units each time; if a non-destructive CCIT method is used, the tested samples can continue to be used for other stability attributes

blocks.zh: 縮短時程：Sterility Test 至少需要 14 天培養期；CCIT 可在數分鐘至數小時內完成
blocks.en: Shortens timelines: The sterility test requires an incubation period of at least 14 days; CCIT can be completed within minutes to hours

blocks.zh: 降低偽陽性風險：Sterility Test 的偽陽性（操作污染）是業界長期痛點，CCIT 排除了此變數
blocks.en: Reduces false-positive risk: False positives in sterility testing (from operator contamination) have long been an industry pain point; CCIT eliminates this variable

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CCIT 無法取代放行階段的無菌試驗？從「CCIT 測試什麼」vs.「Sterility Test 測試什麼」的角度思考。
blocks.en: Why can CCIT not replace sterility testing at release? Think about it from the angle of "what CCIT tests" vs. "what the sterility test tests".

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 同時代工生物製品與小分子藥品，本指引是否兩者皆適用？法規依據為何？
blocks.en: A CDMO manufactures both biological products and small-molecule drugs for clients. Does this guidance apply to both? What is the regulatory basis?

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211.166 (安定性測試) 與 21 CFR 211.167 (批次放行測試) 各規範安定性計畫的哪個面向？
blocks.en: Which aspects of the stability program are governed by 21 CFR 211.166 (stability testing) and 21 CFR 211.167 (batch release testing), respectively?

blocks.zh: II. Introduction 導論
blocks.en: II. Introduction

blocks.zh: Continuing Sterility (持續無菌性): 產品自放行至效期結束的整個期間，必須維持無菌狀態。這不是一次性的證明，而是持續性的保證。安定性計畫的無菌相關測試就是為了提供此保證。
blocks.en: Continuing Sterility: The product must remain sterile for the entire period from release to the end of shelf life. This is not a one-time demonstration but an ongoing assurance. The sterility-related testing in the stability program exists to provide this assurance.

blocks.zh: Sterility Test 的局限性 (Limitations): FDA 在此處預告了後續 Section IV 將詳述的內容——Sterility Test 在可靠性、準確性和結論推導上存在根本性限制。這是推動 CCIT 替代的科學基礎。
blocks.en: Limitations of the Sterility Test: Here FDA previews what Section IV will explain in detail: the sterility test has fundamental limitations in reliability, accuracy and the conclusions that can be drawn from it. This is the scientific basis for promoting CCIT as a replacement.

blocks.zh: 傳統的安定性無菌試驗就像「定期開門檢查冰箱裡的食物有沒有壞掉」——每次開門都有讓外部細菌進入的風險（偽陽性），而且你只能在打開的那一刻看到狀況。CCIT 則像是在冰箱門上裝了溫度感測器和密封監測器，不需要開門就能確認密封狀態是否完好。
blocks.en: The traditional sterility test in a stability program is like "opening the refrigerator door from time to time to check whether the food has gone bad": every time the door is opened, outside bacteria may get in (false positive), and you can only see the condition at the moment the door is open. CCIT is like installing a temperature sensor and a seal monitor on the refrigerator door, so you can confirm that the seal is intact without opening it.

blocks.zh: 測試頻率基線：FDA 指出安定性計畫中 Sterility Test 的最低要求是在「初始時間點（放行）」和「最終測試區間（效期）」執行，中間通常每年測試一次。這設定了 CCIT 替代後應維持的最低頻率基準。
blocks.en: Baseline testing frequency: FDA notes that the minimum requirement for sterility testing in a stability program is to test at the "initial time point (release)" and the "final testing interval (expiry)", with testing typically once a year in between. This sets the minimum frequency baseline that should be maintained once CCIT is used as the replacement.

blocks.zh: 方法不做具體指定：FDA 刻意不指定具體的 CCIT 方法或接受標準，將此責任留給製造商依科學原則決定。這與 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) Section 8.21 的理念一致——「容器密封完整性應使用經驗證且適當靈敏的方法確認」**(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.21)**。
blocks.en: No specific method prescribed: FDA deliberately does not specify a particular CCIT method or acceptance criteria, leaving this responsibility to the manufacturer to decide based on scientific principles. This is consistent with the philosophy of PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) Section 8.21: "container closure integrity should be confirmed using a validated and appropriately sensitive method" **(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.21)**.

blocks.zh: USP <1207> 的角色：雖然 FDA 在 2008 年發布此 Guidance 時 USP <1207> 尚在發展中（2016 年正式發布），但現今 USP <1207> 已成為選擇和驗證 CCIT 方法的主要技術參考，將容器密封完整性測試方法分為確定性方法 (Deterministic Methods) 與概率性方法 (Probabilistic Methods)。
blocks.en: Role of USP <1207>: When FDA issued this Guidance in 2008, USP <1207> was still under development (formally published in 2016). Today USP <1207> is the main technical reference for selecting and validating CCIT methods, and it classifies container closure integrity test methods into Deterministic Methods and Probabilistic Methods.

blocks.zh: 安定性計畫中，CCIT 的最低測試頻率應為何？是否可以只在初始時間點和效期測試？
blocks.en: What should the minimum CCIT testing frequency in a stability program be? Is it acceptable to test only at the initial time point and at expiry?

blocks.zh: FDA 為什麼選擇不在本 Guidance 中指定具體的 CCIT 方法？這種「performance-based」的法規策略對 CDMO 有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why did FDA choose not to specify a particular CCIT method in this Guidance? What does this "performance-based" regulatory strategy mean for a CDMO?

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 使用 vial + stopper + aluminum seal 的容器系統，針對此系統應考慮哪些 CCIT 方法？（提示：參考 USP <1207> 的分類）
blocks.en: Your CDMO uses a vial + stopper + aluminum seal container system. Which CCIT methods should be considered for this system? (Hint: refer to the USP <1207> classification)

blocks.zh: III. Definitions 定義
blocks.en: III. Definitions

blocks.zh: Container and Closure System (容器密封系統): 不僅僅是「瓶子加蓋子」，而是所有包裝組件的總和。FDA 使用「entirety of packaging components」一詞，強調 CCI 必須考慮系統整體，而非單一組件。
blocks.en: Container and Closure System: More than just "a bottle plus a cap"; it is the sum of all packaging components. FDA uses the phrase "entirety of packaging components" to stress that CCI must consider the system as a whole rather than a single component.

blocks.zh: Packaging Component (包裝組件): 容器密封系統中的任何單一部件。FDA 列舉了完整的範例清單：
blocks.en: Packaging Component: Any single part of the container and closure system. FDA lists a complete set of examples:

blocks.zh: 容器 (Containers): Ampules (安瓿)、Vials (西林瓶)、Bottles (瓶)
blocks.en: Containers: Ampules, Vials, Bottles

blocks.zh: 密封件 (Closures): Screw Caps (螺旋蓋)、Stoppers (膠塞)
blocks.en: Closures: Screw Caps, Stoppers

blocks.zh: 輔助組件: Container Liners (內襯)、Closure Liners (蓋墊)、Stopper Overseals (鋁蓋/翻蓋)、Administration Ports (給藥口)、Overwraps (外包裝)、Container Labels (標籤)
blocks.en: Ancillary components: Container Liners, Closure Liners, Stopper Overseals (aluminum seals/flip-off caps), Administration Ports, Overwraps, Container Labels

blocks.zh: Container and Closure System 就像「餐廳的餐具系統」——不只是碗和蓋子，還包括保鮮膜、密封條、外包裝盒等所有保護食物的組件。你不會只檢查碗有沒有裂，而忽略保鮮膜有沒有破洞。同理，CCIT 必須評估整個系統的完整性，而非僅測試單一組件。
blocks.en: A container and closure system is like a "restaurant's food storage system": not just the bowl and the lid, but also the plastic wrap, sealing strips, outer packaging box and every other component that protects the food. You would not check only whether the bowl is cracked and ignore holes in the plastic wrap. Likewise, CCIT must evaluate the integrity of the entire system, not just a single component.

blocks.zh: 定義的實務意義：此定義直接影響 CCIT 方法的選擇。例如：
blocks.en: Practical significance of the definition: This definition directly affects the choice of CCIT method. For example:

blocks.zh: Vial system (西林瓶系統): 包含 Glass Vial + Rubber Stopper + Aluminum Crimp Seal。CCIT 必須能檢測所有三個組件交界面的洩漏
blocks.en: Vial system: Consists of a Glass Vial + Rubber Stopper + Aluminum Crimp Seal. The CCIT method must be able to detect leakage at the interfaces among all three components

blocks.zh: Pre-filled Syringe (預充填注射器): 包含 Glass Barrel + Plunger Stopper + Tip Cap/Needle Shield。每個接合面都是潛在洩漏路徑
blocks.en: Pre-filled Syringe: Consists of a Glass Barrel + Plunger Stopper + Tip Cap/Needle Shield. Every joint interface is a potential leak path

blocks.zh: Bag system (軟袋系統): 包含 Film Body + Port + Overwrap。焊接處和 Port 接合處是關鍵測試點
blocks.en: Bag system: Consists of a Film Body + Port + Overwrap. The welds and the port joints are the critical test points

blocks.zh: PDA Technical Report No. 27 (Pharmaceutical Package Integrity) 對各類容器系統的 CCI 測試方法有更詳細的技術指引 **(PDA TR27)**。
blocks.en: PDA Technical Report No. 27 (Pharmaceutical Package Integrity) provides more detailed technical guidance on CCI test methods for various container systems **(PDA TR27)**.

blocks.zh: CDMO 容器密封系統清單管理：作為 CDMO，你可能為不同客戶使用多種容器密封系統。建議建立一份完整的容器密封系統矩陣，包含：
blocks.en: CDMO container closure system inventory management: As a CDMO, you may use many different container closure systems for different clients. It is recommended to build a complete container closure system matrix that includes:

blocks.zh: 每種產品使用的容器密封系統組件清單
blocks.en: The list of container closure system components used for each product

blocks.zh: 各系統對應的已驗證 CCIT 方法
blocks.en: The validated CCIT method corresponding to each system

blocks.zh: 測試參數和接受標準
blocks.en: Test parameters and acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: Bracketing Matrix (分群矩陣) 的適用性評估——相同容器類型的產品是否可以共用驗證數據（參見 Section VII 及 ICH Q1D）
blocks.en: An assessment of the applicability of a Bracketing Matrix: whether products with the same container type can share validation data (see Section VII and ICH Q1D)

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 使用 2R、6R、10R、20R 四種規格的 vial，搭配相同的 stopper 和 crimp seal。在 CCIT 驗證時，是否需要對每種規格分別驗證？（提示：考慮 Bracketing 策略）
blocks.en: Your CDMO uses vials in four sizes (2R, 6R, 10R and 20R) with the same stopper and crimp seal. Does CCIT validation need to be performed separately for each size? (Hint: consider a bracketing strategy)

blocks.zh: Container Label (容器標籤) 為什麼被列為 Packaging Component？它如何影響容器密封完整性？
blocks.en: Why is the Container Label listed as a Packaging Component? How does it affect container closure integrity?

blocks.zh: Pre-filled Syringe 的 CCIT 挑戰與 Vial System 有何不同？哪些洩漏路徑是 PFS 特有的？
blocks.en: How do the CCIT challenges of a Pre-filled Syringe differ from those of a Vial System? Which leak paths are specific to a PFS?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 核心主張：FDA 建議在安定性計畫中以 CCIT 取代 Sterility Test，因為後者存在可靠性、準確性和結論推導上的根本限制
blocks.en: Core position: FDA recommends replacing the sterility test with CCIT in the stability program, because the sterility test has fundamental limitations in reliability, accuracy and the conclusions that can be drawn from it

blocks.zh: 適用範疇：涵蓋生物製品、人用/動物用藥品、醫療器械的核准前與核准後安定性計畫，但不適用於放行無菌試驗
blocks.en: Scope: Covers pre-approval and post-approval stability programs for biological products, human and animal drugs and medical devices, but does not apply to release sterility testing

blocks.zh: 法規依據：21 CFR 211.166 (安定性測試)、21 CFR 211.167 (放行測試)、21 CFR 610.12 (生物製品無菌試驗) 構成法規框架
blocks.en: Regulatory basis: 21 CFR 211.166 (stability testing), 21 CFR 211.167 (release testing) and 21 CFR 610.12 (sterility testing of biological products) form the regulatory framework

blocks.zh: 定義澄清：Container and Closure System 是所有包裝組件的整體，CCIT 必須評估整個系統而非單一組件
blocks.en: Definition clarified: The Container and Closure System is the whole of all packaging components, and CCIT must evaluate the entire system rather than a single component

blocks.zh: 方法靈活性：FDA 不指定具體方法，製造商依科學原則選擇適合其容器系統的 CCIT 方法（現可參考 USP <1207> 分類架構）
blocks.en: Method flexibility: FDA does not specify a particular method; manufacturers choose the CCIT method suited to their container system based on scientific principles (the USP <1207> classification framework can now be used as a reference)

blocks.zh: CDMO 啟示：CCIT 替代可節省安定性樣品、縮短測試時程、降低偽陽性風險，是安定性計畫優化的重要契機
blocks.en: Takeaway for CDMOs: Replacing the sterility test with CCIT saves stability samples, shortens testing timelines and reduces false-positive risk, making it an important opportunity to optimize the stability program
